title: Abla

characters.SIS: a girl of about twelve with long black hair in one braid, wearing a blue school pinafore over a white shirt
characters.LITTLE: her little brother, a boy of about six with messy brown hair, wearing a green sweater
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty-five with long black hair in one braid, wearing a blue coat
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty with messy brown hair, wearing a green sweater

scenes.text:
Ablan, sen doğduğun gün
biraz büyümek zorunda kaldı.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy lamp-lit bedroom at night, {SIS} leans over a wooden cradle and looks at a sleeping baby with a serious, caring face, snow falling softly outside the window.

scenes.text:
Okul yolunda
çantanı hep o taşırdı.
scenes.prompt: {SIS} walks along a leafy autumn path carrying two school backpacks, a blue one and a small yellow one, while {LITTLE} runs ahead happily chasing falling leaves.

scenes.text:
Arkadaşları oynarken o,
kapıda seni beklerdi.
scenes.prompt: {SIS} sits alone on the front steps of a house, waiting patiently, while other children play ball in the distance under golden autumn trees, leaves drifting down.

scenes.text:
Sen büyüdün;
kimse ona "Sen de çocuktun" demedi.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} sits alone by a rainy window in the evening, looking out thoughtfully, a cup of tea on the windowsill in front of her, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Bugün o cümleyi ona sen söyle.
Bunu ablana gönder.
scenes.prompt: On a park bench under a big autumn tree at sunset, {WOMAN} on the left and {MAN} on the right sit close together, his arm around her shoulder, she smiles with teary eyes, golden leaves falling.

caption:
Ablana teşekkür ettin mi?

Bazı ablalar çocukluklarının yarısını kardeşlerine verir. 🤍

Bunu ablana gönder.
